theModel.label: THE MODEL
theModel.title: A library for the whole district.
theModel.lead: Most study halls are either crowded commercial cubicles or silent archives where conversation is forbidden. The Knowledge Commons is planned as a balanced space for serious readers, fellows, and students.

pillars.title: Quiet Desks
pillars.summary: Individual study desks reserved for deep, undisturbed reading and preparation.

pillars.title: Reference Collections
pillars.summary: Hand-picked foundational texts in mathematics, natural sciences, history, and craft.

pillars.title: Paper Club
pillars.summary: Weekly reading group where fellows and students read primary papers and classic essays aloud.

pillars.title: Physical Question Board
pillars.summary: A wall board in the reading room where anyone can pin an unresolved problem for others to examine.

access.label: READER CARDS
access.title: How reader cards will work.
